Result start index. The one-based index of the first result to be returned in the list of resources. For example, to exclude the first two resources, use a *startIndex* value of 3. Attribute whitelist filter string. A comma-separated list of resource attribute names to be returned in the response, overriding the set of attributes that would be returned by default. Attribute blacklist filter string. A comma-separated list of resource attribute names to be excluded in the response, overriding the set of attributes that would be returned by default. Attribute names must be specified in standard attribute notation (see [RFC 7644 section 3.10](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7644#section-3.10).)
